name: complete-digestive-tract
thesis: The organism has a COMPLETE digestive tract. CF tunnel was the black hole (pure gravity intake). WireGuard was the anus (old egress). Both excreted. What remains: mouth(RSS) → teeth(AI) → stomach(sourDough) → gut(eastGate) → dromedary(absorption) → RSS(excretion). 1-way spine with feedback loop.

1_mouth.function: 700+ feeds pour IN: Wikipedia, HN, arxiv, xkcd, lobsters
1_mouth.analogy: Porkbun DNS = lips that open the mouth. SEO = smell that draws food in.

2_teeth.analogy: BLACKWALL = enamel. Rejects bots (gristle). Accepts nutrients.

3_tongue.function: 19 crate taste buds. TTY cis/trans. spore-words GIS. 7 modes.
3_tongue.analogy: Tastes incoming data. Routes to correct organ. Knows WHERE it tastes.

4_stomach.analogy: Acid breaks down raw OSINT. Only nutrients survive.

5_gut.analogy: Small intestine absorbs nutrients. Large intestine compacts waste.

6_black_hole.was: 0 outbound fetches, 30 FOLDS, PURE GRAVITY — pulled everything in
6_black_hole.now: DISSOLVED → dromedary replaced it. Sovereign. No middleman.

7_anus.was: Old egress tunnel. Data pushed OUT through VPS/golgi/mesh.
7_anus.now: ALL EXCRETED: wg0 DOWN, golgi DOWN, VPS DEAD, ZK tunnels DEAD.
excreted_items: WireGuard mesh → excreted (wg0 DOWN, all peers removed)
7_anus.signal: Exhaust IS signal, not waste. The deprecated patterns TAUGHT the organism what it doesn't need.

dissolution_endgame.savings: From $$$+/month to $10/year. The organism feeds ITSELF.

feedback_loop.flow: Porkbun(DNS) → dromedary(route) → eastGate(digest) → RSS(publish) → SEO → MORE visitors → Porkbun...
feedback_loop.insight: The RSS output FEEDS the SEO input. The organism FEEDS ITSELF through a 1-way digestive spine with a feedback loop.

connections.pore_dissolution: The tor pore IS the sphincter — selective, one-way, controlled.
connections.petaltongue: PETALTONGUE sits between mouth and stomach — the tongue in the tract.
connections.yeast_cell: The tract IS the yeast cell's vacuole + Golgi + ER chain.
connections.triple_point: Water flows ONE WAY through the tract (ice→water→steam→condensation).
